title: Sudakov minoration for unconditional log-concave vectors with negatively associated magnitudes
summary: We prove the Sudakov minoration principle, with a universal constant, for unconditional log-concave random vectors whose coordinate magnitudes are negatively associated. The main step is a deterministic selection theorem: pairwise witnesses in convex downwardclosed sets yield, on an exponentially large subfamily, one fixed witness per label separating it from every other retained label. The selection combines a prefix counting inequality with convex separation in the space of all label-coordinate arrays.
